major_cooldowns.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon it with Call Dreadstalkers already out and on cooldown so the Tyrant extends them, and maximize the number of demons summoned before you press it since it gains a damage modifier per demon.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it into your Demonic Tyrant window for the damage, and use the Singe Magic it grants while it is down to dispel yourself or a party member.

major_cooldowns.name: Grimoire: Fel Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take it over Grimoire: Imp Lord when you need the on-demand interrupt, and send it into your Demonic Tyrant window for the damage.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses (all five played Grimoire: Imp Lord); the guide names it as the more common choice for its on-demand interrupt, and gives access to Spell Lock while it is down. base_cd_s from the table.

major_cooldowns.name: Summon Doomguard
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it whenever multiple targets are up, and remember it only hits five enemies at once so it does not scale past that cap.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses; both the guide's AoE priority and the simc APL list it as a real button in every build sampled. base_cd_s from the table.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Siphon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it a few seconds before the pull with two Wild Imps out, and press it again once your Demonic Core stacks drop to one or fewer.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses; the guide lists it as the top single-target priority item and the simc APL casts it precombat and on cooldown at low Demonic Core stacks, so it is a real button for its build. base_cd_s from the table.

defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a heavy raid hit for the damage reduction.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Shield yourself ahead of predictable incoming damage.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Coil a nearby enemy to heal yourself and briefly disable it when you need the breathing room.

defensives.name: Singe Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Use it to dispel a harmful magic effect from yourself or a party member while your Grimoire is on cooldown.

rules.description: Open Imp Lord into Dreadstalkers, Tyrant, Hand of Gul'dan
rules.action: Send your Grimoire and Call Dreadstalkers before Summon Demonic Tyrant, then spend Hand of Gul'dan inside the window.

rules.description: Call Dreadstalkers out before Summon Demonic Tyrant
rules.action: Send Call Dreadstalkers out and on cooldown before you summon the Tyrant so it extends them.

rules.description: Spend Hand of Gul'dan only at 3+ Soul Shards
rules.action: Hold Hand of Gul'dan until you have banked enough Soul Shards rather than spending them low.

rules.description: Do not overcap Soul Shards with Demonbolt
rules.action: Spend into Call Dreadstalkers or Hand of Gul'dan before pressing Demonbolt again if it would overcap your shards.

rules.description: Do not overcap Soul Shards with Shadow Bolt
rules.action: Spend your Soul Shards before Shadow Bolt would push you to the cap.

rules.description: Demonbolt is the filler on Demonic Core, not Shadow Bolt
rules.action: Press Demonbolt whenever Demonic Core is up and save Shadow Bolt for when it is down.

rules.description: Do not overcap Demonic Core with Power Siphon
rules.action: Hold Power Siphon while you already have Demonic Core stacks banked, and press it once you are down to one or none.

rules.description: Implosion only with several targets up
rules.action: Save your Wild Imps and implode with the full six only once several enemies are up.

rules.description: Summon Doomguard only with several targets up
rules.action: Save Summon Doomguard for packs, since it caps its damage at five targets.
